claim: 萨迦得名于灰白土；1073 年昆·贡却杰布（1034–1102）建萨迦寺，为该传统第一座寺院与法座；围墙三色故俗称花教（参考级）。
locator: en.wikipedia Sakya：'The name Sakya ("pale earth") derives from the unique grey landscape of the Ponpori Hills in southern Tibet near Shigatse, where Sakya Monastery, the first monastery of this tradition, and the seat of the Sakya School was built by Khon Konchog Gyalpo (1034–1102) in 1073.'；zh.wikipedia 萨迦派：'萨迦"一词的藏语意思是灰白色，因为此派主寺萨迦寺建立之处土色灰白，故名'＋'因主寺围墙上涂有象征密宗三大怙主……之红、白、藍黑三色条纹，故常被称为花教'
note: 花教/三色墙出自带'没有列出任何参考或来源'横幅的 zh.wiki 条目，仅作参考级定位（S6 coverage 已声明）。
uncertainty: 花教称谓单源（无来源横幅条目）。

claim: 昆氏家族男系世袭是萨迦的组织特征；卓弥译师在超戒寺从 Naropa 等学十二年。
locator: en.wikipedia Sakya：'The leadership of the Sakya School is passed down through a hereditary system between the male members of the Sakya branch of the Khon family.'；'It was founded by Drogmi, a famous scholar and translator who had studied at the Vikramashila directly under Naropa, Ratnākaraśānti, Vāgīśvarakīrti and other great panditas from India for twelve years.'

claim: 道果为萨迦最高教法；根本文本为毗瓦巴《金刚句》；传统叙事称本尊 Nairātmyā 授予毗瓦巴（圣传层）；1041 年经 Gayadhara 与卓弥入藏。
locator: en.wikipedia Lamdre：'Lamdré is a meditative system in Tibetan Buddhism rooted in the view that the result of its practice is contained within the path. The name "lamdré" means the "path" (Wylie: lam) with its fruit Wylie: 'bras). In Tibet, the lamdré teachings are considered the summum bonum of the Sakya school.'；'According to traditional accounts, the lamdré teachings were originally bestowed upon Virūpa, an Indian monk, by the tantric deity Nairātmyā.'；'Lamdré entered Tibet through the Indian paṇḍita Gayadhara (d. 1103) in 1041. Gayādhara worked with a Tibetan lotsawa, Drogmi Śākya Yeshe (Wylie: 'brog mi śākya ye shes, 993-1077?), to translate a plethora of Buddhist tantras from Indian classical and vernacular languages.'
note: 起源层按 traditional accounts 处理，不作史实。
uncertainty: Gayadhara 卒年 d.1103 与同条系谱表 994–1043 矛盾；Drogmi 993-1077? 与系谱表 992–1074 矛盾。

claim: 贡噶宁波以十八年掌握道果、作《金刚句》注十一部；道果见地为'果在道中'与轮回涅槃不二；口传保密、部分教授至今无文字。
locator: en.wikipedia Lamdre：'A student of Drogmi Lotsāwa, Chos bar, instructed Sachen Künga Nyingpo, who is considered the founder of the Sakya school of Tibetan Buddhism. Sachen mastered the teachings over a period of eighteen years and wrote several explications of the root text of the Lamdré system.'；'The lamdré system is rooted in a very specific view, that the path and its result are contained within each other. All beings have an inherently enlightened nature'；'The view that saṃsāra (cyclical existence) and nirvāṇa (liberation from suffering) are indivisible illuminates the Lamdré teachings.'；'the instructions for meditation are passed orally from mentor to student ... This tradition continues to the present day, where some oral teachings remain unwritten, known only by lamdré lineage holders.'；'eleven commentaries on the Vajra Verses were written by Sachen Künga Nyingpo.'
note: 口传保密性质入 evidenceLimits 第一条。

claim: 道果分 tshogs bshad（会众解释）/slobs bshad（近传解释）两线，后世以 slob bshad 为标准；扎巴坚赞作五阶段总结。
locator: en.wikipedia Sakya：'The main Dharma system of the Sakya school is the "Path with its Result" (Wylie: lam dang 'bras bu bcas), which is split into two main lineages, "Explanation for the Assembly" (Wylie: tshogs bshad) and the "Explanation for Close Disciples" (Wylie: slobs bshad).'；en.wikipedia Lamdre：'Jetsün Dragpa Gyaltsen summarized the path into five stages: Initiation The creation stage The completion stage Training Concluding practice with tantric seals'；'eventually most Sakyapas agreed that the Slob bshad teachings were the standard.'

claim: 离四贪着四颂为贡噶宁波所传，扎巴坚赞、萨迦班智达、俄尔钦、果让巴皆作疏；四颂英译逐字。
locator: en.wikipedia Sakya：'Another important series of teachings is based on verses of Günga Nyingpo (1092–1158) called "separating from the four attachments" which is the subject of commentaries by numerous Sakya masters like Drakpa Gyeltsen, Sakya Pandita, Ngorchen Günga Sangpo, and Gorampa Sönam Senggé. The verses are: If you cling to this life, then you are not a dharma practitioner. If you cling to existence, then you do not have renunciation. If you are attached to your own interests, then you do not have the mind of awakening. If you hold to a position, then you do not have the correct view.'

claim: 《量理宝藏论》批判智军（1109–1169）的法称诠释；Padmakara 称其为 magnum opus 并'champions antirealism'；Sapan 的批判性立场（怀疑跳过次第的即身成佛论）。
locator: en.wikipedia Sakya Pandita：'In his Treasure of Reasoning (Rigs gter), he roundly critiques Chapa Chökyi Sengé's (1109–1169) interpretation of Dharmakirti's thought.'；'the Tsod-ma rigs-gter, a celebrated work many consider Sakya Paṇḍita's magnum opus, champions Dhamakirti's 'antirealism' by countering Chapa's (phya pa chos kyi seng ge, 1109–1169) interpretation of Dharmakirti.'；'He was suspicious of lamas who promised enlightenment without going through the consecutive stages of Buddhist practices, and he took a more conservative view.'

claim: 白法批判：dkar po chig thub 界定（Cabezón）、点名冈波巴与张·察巴；影响五世达赖等后世。
locator: en.wikipedia Sakya Pandita：'Sakya Pandita is also known as a critic of a certain kind of Mahamudra theory and practice called White Panacea (dkar po chig thub) or "self-sufficient white remedy." According to Cabezon, this "is the doctrine that "the realization of the nature of mind is sufficient in and of itself to bring about spontaneously and instantaneously the simultaneous consummation of all virtuous qualities, including Buddhahood itself."" Sapan focused his critique on the figure of Gampopa (1079–1153), and his disciple, Zhang Tshal pa (1123–93). His critique was influential on numerous later figures, including the Fifth Dalai Lama (1617–82), Jamyang Shepe Dorje Ngawang Tsondrü (1648–1722) and the Second Belmang, Konchok Gyeltsen (1764–1853).'
note: 批判针对的是噶举极端化表述；review.md 记'不放大为否定大手印'的警告。
uncertainty: 冈波巴本人体系是否即靶心，来源（转述 Cabezón）未区分。

claim: 《三律仪辨别论》第 255 颂立'离戏'最高见；SEP 记 spros bral'后来被立为萨迦传统的正统观点'；果让巴（1429–1489）对宗喀巴后期立场持续批判。
locator: Lotsawa House 三律仪节偈（Ch.3 v.255）：'Were there a view higher than the non-elaboration Of the transcendental perfection of wisdom, It would be a view with conceptual elaboration. Were it unelaborate, there would be no difference.'；SEP Tsongkhapa：'characterizing the ultimate as an absence of elaboration (niṣprapañca; spros bral) beyond the four extremes, later set forth as the orthodox view of the Sakya tradition. Tsongkhapa's rejection of this characterization in his later work gives rise to sustained critique of his views by writers like Gorampa Sonam Senge (Go rams pa bsod nams sge ge, 1429–1489) (Cabezon & Dargyay 2007; Yakherds 2021).'
uncertainty: 果让巴著作内部结构未核（S1 仅及论战事实）。
